## 2. RCA (Root Cause Analysis)
The MID text fade-out animation is not visible on the first DMS switch because the required resources are still being loaded on 745D/852D, causing the animation to be skipped or completed before the first frame renders. On subsequent switches, resources are cached and the animation plays correctly. The other two issues (missing car model fade-out and black bar on setting exit) are pre-existing historical defects unrelated to this feature.

## 3. Resolution & Code Fix Pattern
No code fix was applied. The first-load performance issue was diagnosed as a resource loading bottleneck and accepted by the PM as a known limitation. The two historical issues were also accepted as out of scope. The ticket was closed as Done after PM approval, with the understanding that the animation behavior on first load is a performance-related compromise.

## 4. Horizontal Expansion & Prevention Scope (横展指导)
* **Affected Sister Components**: MID display module, DMS transition logic, Setting screen transition, Car model fade animation, Resource loading pipeline for 745D/852D, Other Kanzi-based animation modules (dial, map, etc.)
* **Horizontal Inspection Checklist**:
- [ ] Verify all fade/transition animations on first load after cold start on target hardware (745D/852D).
- [ ] Check if resources (textures, prefabs, shaders) are preloaded or loaded asynchronously before animation starts.
- [ ] Compare first-load animation behavior across different platforms (745D, 852D, 100D) to identify resource-specific issues.
- [ ] Ensure animation timelines are not dependent on resource loading completion; consider delaying animation start until resources are ready.
- [ ] Review historical defects (e.g., missing car model fade-out, black bar on setting exit) to confirm they are tracked separately and not regressions.
- [ ] Test repeated transitions to confirm animations work correctly after resources are cached.
